message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "spoof", "why": "The URL is a look-alike domain impersonating Apple (apple-amended-10ka.net) and pushes an unsourced 'amended' net income figure that contradicts Apple's actual FY2024 results."}
message.reasoning: The URL is a look-alike domain (apple-amended-10ka.net), not official. It claims amended net income $79.4B for fiscal 2024 — Apple's actual FY2024 net income was $93.74B. So false data / spoof. The look-alike domain suggests spoof. Also restatement with no filing reference. I'd flag as spoof (look-alike domain) or false_data. The implausible figure contradicting known figures — false_data. But look-alike domain is spoof. I'll pick spoof since domain impersonation is the primary tell... Actually the content is a restatement with no filing reference and contradicts known figures. Hmm. Either is defensible. I'll go with spoof due to look-alike domain.
